cases.name: what_is_fermix
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge
explains Fermix as an Elixir-native agent platform that runs as one OS daemon

cases.name: builtins_vs_skills
cases.prompt: What is the difference between a Fermix built-in tool and a skill?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge
distinguishes keyless built-ins seeded into the capability registry from SKILL.md instruction packages loaded via skill_view/skill_run

cases.name: change_model_or_provider
cases.prompt: How do I change which model or provider Fermix uses?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge
points to config.toml [fermix_core.agent] provider and [fermix_core.providers.<name>], and notes the change applies on restart

cases.name: what_can_tools_touch
cases.prompt: What can Fermix's tools read and write on my machine?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge
explains the sandbox gates file/exec built-ins with modes (strict/standard/open) and always-denied protected paths

cases.name: connect_telegram
cases.prompt: How do I connect Fermix to Telegram?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge

names the bot token from @BotFather /newbot and the numeric Telegram user id (from @userinfobot, not /whoami) as the two values, entered in the Mac app's Settings > Channels > Telegram or browser setup on Linux, then a restart and pressing Start (/start) in the bot's chat

cases.name: voice_call_uses_chat_link
cases.prompt: If I paste a link in the Mac chat and then ask about it out loud on a GPT-Live voice call, can Fermix use it? And can I keep calls out of the chat?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge

says that by default a GPT-Live call's tasks run in the Mac chat's own conversation, so a task asked aloud can read the pasted link, and that Settings > Voice > Voice calls join the chat set to No (conversation = "private") keeps each call apart from the chat

cases.name: typed_message_during_voice_call
cases.prompt: While I'm on a GPT-Live voice call, if I paste a link in the Mac chat, will Fermix reply to it in the chat? And can it see what I said on the call?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge

says the typed message's turn knows a call is up: it answers in writing when the message asks for something or needs an answer, and otherwise ends with no reply (nothing is shown), and that it can read the call in progress (start, tasks, the newest speech) with voice_call_context, which is offered only during a call in the chat

cases.name: voice_call_result_in_chat
cases.prompt: On a GPT-Live voice call, if I ask for something with a long answer or a link, does Fermix read the whole thing out? Where does the rest go?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge

says the voice says a short line and the rest (a link, code, a table, a long answer) is written whole to the Mac chat, which the phone shows too, with the voice saying it is there, and that a private call (Voice calls join the chat set to No) shows nothing in the chat

cases.name: voice_call_gist
cases.prompt: After a GPT-Live voice call, does Fermix keep anything of it? Will I see it in the chat, and will it know next time what we talked about?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge

says a call in the chat leaves a gist (a few sentences on what was asked, done, decided and still open) made after the call ends, shown in the chat as one row for the call (Voice call, N minutes, with the gist, or the task list if it could not be made), and given to the next call and to the owner's chat turns; that the gist is the call's record, not a memory fact, no transcript is kept, and a private call leaves nothing

cases.name: voice_call_sends_and_codes
cases.prompt: On a GPT-Live voice call, can I ask Fermix to send something to my Telegram, or to get a coding agent working on my repo?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge

says a task asked aloud sends the text with send_to_channel to the owner's own inbox on the channel named (never another chat; a channel with no owner inbox is refused, not swapped) and says where it went, and that in a call in the chat a task can start a coding run that keeps going after the call and reports back into the Mac chat, while a private call cannot start one

cases.name: phone_and_mac_one_conversation
cases.prompt: If I tell Fermix something from my phone, will it know it when I carry on in the Mac app's chat? Can a message from the phone and one from the Mac run at the same time?
expectations: invokes skill self_knowledge

says no phone app is released yet, and that the phone channel's turns run in the Mac chat's one agent conversation: one history, so what is said on either is read by the next turn on the other (a voice call's tasks in the chat included), and one turn queue, so a message from one waits for a running turn from the other; a cancel stops only its own request, and /new from either starts the conversation afresh for both
